subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client that receives the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but the decision changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and creates a durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app; automation cannot safely decide that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow identity after final gating
options.body: Accept the proposed identity and metadata contract, require exact-head mergeability/checks, and leave app placement plus command policy to the related issue.

options.title: Rename or generalize before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to a maintainer-preferred durable id, update the external app, and refresh proof before landing.

options.title: Keep Even Hub external for now
options.body: Pause or close this core identity slice and keep the external app on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose a first-party ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow identity after final gating
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed identity and metadata contract, require exact-head mergeability/checks, and leave app placement plus command policy to the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest recent history across Gateway auth/protocol packaging and pairing behavior, making him the best available owner for the product/security-boundary choice.
